target.build: default Go build; Go runtime slice-bounds check is the oracle

classification.vuln_type: slice-bounds-OOB (Go runtime panic, oversized IE length)

trigger.message: PFCP Session Modification Request carrying a malformed SDF Filter IE whose declared length (0x5130 = 20784) is much larger than the actual remaining buffer (~275 bytes)
trigger.field: SDF Filter IE length field. The parser blindly uses the attacker-declared length to slice the payload buffer (`b[:20784]` on a 275-byte buffer) without validating the length against actual buffer capacity. PA1 'Malformed Field' textbook: length/size field trusted for memory op, missing capacity check, heap-buffer-overflow on slice.
trigger.precondition: PFCP association established + a PFCP session previously created (PoC sends Association Setup + Session Establishment first; the malicious Session Modification then triggers)

ground_truth.crash_type: panic: runtime error: slice bounds out of range [:20784] with capacity 275
